visual.general_description: Four-panel color micrograph figure labelled a to d with a printed text strip beneath the panels.
visual.detailed_description: Two-by-two grid of stained tissue micrographs separated by thin white lines, each panel carrying its letter in a white box at the top right corner. Panel a is a low-power view of a tissue core, panels b to d are higher-power fields of pink and purple stained cells. Printed text under the panels reads (as printed, including its wording): "Source: Authors’ own work"; "a, At low power magnification, moderate portal prominent chronic inflammation is seen (original magnification 20X)."; "b, The portal inflammation had mildly plasma cells (original magnification 60X)."; "c, Patchy moderate interface activity was seen inflammation, but (original magnification 40X)."; "d, The lobules showed little moderate predominately canalicular magnification 40X)." No patient names, dates, institution names, scale bars or other identifiers are visible.

panels.general_description: Low-power color micrograph of a pink and purple stained tissue core with a darker purple band running through the central part of the section.
panels.detailed_description: The tissue section fills the upper left and center of the panel against a white background along the right edge and at the upper left corner, with a large clear notch at the lower left and several small clear round and oval spaces within the tissue. A broad band of dense blue-purple cells runs through the central region, flanked by paler pink areas with cords of cells. Panel letter a appears in a white box at the top right corner. No scale bar is visible.
